summary: 主语是动作的承受者时用被动语态：be + 过去分词。各种时态的被动通过变化 be 动词实现。

rules.title: 一般现在时与一般过去时的被动
rules.detail: am/is/are + 过去分词（一般现在时）；was/were + 过去分词（一般过去时）。动作执行者如需说明，用 by 引出。

examples.en: English is spoken by many people.
The classroom is cleaned every day.

rules.title: 含情态动词的被动：情态动词 + be + 过去分词
rules.detail: 结构：情态动词（can / must / should...）+ be + 过去分词。be 永远用原形，时态和单复数的变化都由情态动词承担；否定形式在情态动词后加 not（如 can't be done「不可能被做」）。

examples.en: Trees must be planted in spring.
The problem should be solved right away.
examples.zh: 这个问题应该立即解决。

rules.title: 什么时候用被动？
rules.detail: ① 不知道谁做的；② 承受者比执行者更重要；③ 客观说明。汉语的「被、由、受」常对应英语被动。

examples.en: The song is often sung by children.
examples.zh: 这首歌经常被孩子们唱。

pitfalls: 漏掉 be 动词：❌ The room cleaned every day. → ✓ The room is cleaned every day.
该用过去分词却用原形：❌ English is speak here. → ✓ English is spoken here.
不及物动词不能有被动：❌ The accident was happened yesterday. → ✓ The accident happened yesterday.

questions.stem: Chinese ___ by more and more people around the world now.
questions.explain: Chinese 是「被说」，now 提示一般现在时被动：is spoken。
运动会「被举办」，2022 年是过去，Olympics 视为单数：was held。
情态动词被动语态：must be + 过去分词 protected。

questions.stem: Paper ___ by Cai Lun about 2,000 years ago.
questions.explain: ago 提示一般过去时被动：was invented。

questions.stem: This song ___ (sing) by young people every day.
questions.explain: 一般现在时被动：is + sing 的过去分词 sung。

questions.stem: These photos ___ (take) by my father last year.
questions.explain: photos 复数、last year 过去：were taken。

questions.stem: The meat is smell bad. Don't eat it.
questions.explain: smell（闻起来）是系动词，没有被动语态，直接 smells。

questions.stem: 这些书是给孩子们的。（翻译整句：书被送给孩子们）
answer: these books are given to the children.
these books are given to the kids.
questions.explain: give sth to sb 的被动：books are given to...。

questions.stem: 作业必须按时完成。（翻译整句）
answer: the homework must be finished on time.
homework must be finished on time.
questions.explain: 情态动词被动：must be + 过去分词 finished；on time 按时。
